content:
Sara: quick sync — we have a staged engine cutover tonight in the 00:30-01:15 UTC window. rollout plan attached in release notes, but key bits: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic hold on any perf/error regression. need final ack from ops and runtime leads.

DeployBot: preflight starting in 5m. running smoke checks, binary signatures, and quant-compat matrix. posting results here.

DeployBot: ```
PRELIGHT CHECKS:
- checksum: OK
- binary-sign: OK
- cluster-capacity: OK (reserve 10%)
- kv-cache-smoke: OK
- canary-image-pulls: OK
- quant-build-matrix: WARN (float->int8 mapping differences on arch-a)
- telemetry-hook: OK

If WARN/FAIL seen, deploy will pause and tag for manual review.
```

Eva: regarding the quant WARN — that was expected for the new matmul kernel on arch-a. validated top-5 prompts locally; diff is tiny but we need to watch tail latencies. I pushed a fallback variant (q8-compat) that keeps behavior identical but slightly higher throughput cost.

Ali: thanks Eva. can we ensure smart-routing will prefer q8-compat on arch-a until we get 24h of telemetry? we should avoid user-facing regressions.

Sara: yes — plan is to route arch-a traffic to q8-compat for first 12h post-rollout, then eval for 24h before defaulting back. documented in notes.

Mike R: rollback criteria proposal:
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute for 10m
- 95p latency regression > 30% for 5m
- model-quality alerts from eval harness for 3 consecutive evals
If any trigger, auto-hold + manual rollback within 15m.

Ops Oncall: acking the window. I need the runbook pinned and the oncall remediations updated. add escalation to SRE lead (Ali) if auto-hold fires.

Sara: done — runbook link: https://internal.redwood/release/2798765432 (contains rollback commands and pin TTLs). Quick commands in runbook: `deploybot pin-engine --version v2.14.0 --ttl 2h` and `deploybot rollback-engine --to v2.13.8 --reason "auto-hold"`.

DeployBot: preflight complete. final status: ONE WARN (quant matrix) but fallback variant available. Awaiting green from leads to proceed.

Eva: I recommend proceeding with canary -> 5% only, enable q8-compat on arch-a, collect 30m of telemetry, then decide next step.

Ali: +1. I'll watch infra metrics and set dashboards to highlight 95p and errors. I also put an alert that p95 > 1.3x baseline for 5m triggers page to oncall.

Mike R: I'll run a quick smoke eval set after canary deployment (20 prompts) and post pass/fail.

Sara: plan agreed. proceeding with canary at 00:30 UTC. team oncall: please be available for the 00:30-01:45 window. ping here for any immediate flags. :thumbsup:

Ops Oncall: ack — I will watch and escalate to Ali if needed.

Mike R: smoke eval run queued, will post results in ~10m after canary.

DeployBot: canary rollout started -> 5% traffic on q8-compat for arch-a. job id: cb-2798765432-1

Sara: tagging this thread for visibility. If anyone sees weirdness, use the rollback commands in the runbook and post here.

Mike R: smoke eval: PASS (20/20 prompts within expected thresholds). posting summary: avg quality delta 0.2%, no hallucination increases.

Eva: good signal. continue to 25% after 30m unless alerts.

Ali: dashboards look healthy at 15m. no error spike, p95 stable. holding until 30m then promoting to 25%.

DeployBot: next promotion scheduled in 15m. automatic hold if any alert fires.

Sara: thanks all. will update release notes and close thread once we hit 100% and 24h healthy.

Ops Oncall: adding postmortem checklist to the runbook in case we need one.

Mike R: noted. if rollback happens, I'll capture eval diffs and upload to the runbook.

Sara: final: everyone please react with :eyes: when you see this so we have implicit ack.
